findings.Register: HookAPI exports void RegisterGlobal/RegisterEntry; calls RegisterHook and mutates callback registry. It returns no registry/engine/namespace object.
findings.RegisterEvent: SafeEventAPI exports void RegisterEvent; calls RegisterSafeEvent for separate safeEventMap. It returns no registry/engine/namespace object.
findings.Schedule: Queues callbacks; mutator, not passive observer.
findings.callback_storage: PythonEngine private hookMap (HookInfo -> entryId -> CallbackList), shared hookMutex; HasRegisteredCallbacks calls actual private HasCallbacks.
findings.current_callable_state: Not invoked by this lane. Parent actual finite module inventory is separate evidence; no inference from global config.

findings.existing_passive_exports: strategic_read_acquisition_catalog + strategic_read_source_predicates emit/fingerprint only four hook names; fifth absent from both C++ native handler enumeration and Python callback lists.
findings.namespace: ExecuteCode executes in private main_namespace. Source files, namespace globals, or current function names are not an authoritative mirror of already-registered callbacks.
findings.public_cpp_observer: PythonEngine::HasRegisteredCallbacks(HookInfo,uint32) const is available to native C++ only in selected binding surface.
